versions.changelog:
- Expanded documentation types from Reference and How-To to full Diátaxis quadrants: Tutorial, How-To, Reference, and Explanation
- Updated type detection logic with new Diátaxis keyword table and examples
- Added instructions and rules specific to Tutorial and Explanation documentation, including narrative guidelines and verification criteria
- Incorporated Diátaxis framework decision process and references for more precise doc classification
- Removed `skill-card.md` (no longer required)

- skill-card.md removed; all documentation now consolidated in SKILL.md.
- SKILL.md revised for clarity and simplicity; invocation instructions are shorter and more user-focused.
- Internal skill references now use relative Markdown links for easier navigation.
- No functional or behavioral changes—documentation only.

- Added "Hard gates (sequenced)" section to enforce explicit, stepwise validation before proceeding in each phase.
- Now requires confirmation (via real file system or command outputs) at every major step, especially writing and verifying drafts.
- Clarified that file writes must be confirmed on disk before reporting completion.
- Improved clarity on gating for Context, Type, Skills, and Write steps in the draft generation workflow.
- No logic or workflow changes outside documentation/guidance; core behaviors remain the same.
- Documentation updated for stricter adherence to safe, reproducible draft and publish steps.

- Initial release of the draft-docs skill.
- Generate first-draft technical documentation (Reference or How-To) by analyzing code and project structure.
- Outputs drafts to docs/drafts/, including complete metadata and code examples.
- Supports safe publish workflow: moves reviewed drafts to destination and updates navigation.
- Automated verification checks ensure docs quality and accurate navigation updates.
- Always loads core docs-style guidance for draft consistency.
